name: get_concept
description: Read a concept file in full by name. Accepts the exact kebab-case slug (e.g. 'skillnet') or a fuzzy partial match. Returns the full markdown content without requiring a separate file read.

name.description: Concept name as a kebab-case slug (e.g. 'skillnet', 'hermes-agent-skills') or a partial/fuzzy match string. If multiple files match, the closest match is returned and alternatives listed.

examples.description: Read the SkillNet concept entry by exact slug

output.content:
> **Concept:** SkillNet — Open Infrastructure for Creating, Evaluating, and Connecting AI Agent Skills
...

examples.description: Fuzzy match when unsure of exact slug

output.content:
> **Concept:** Hermes Agent — Skills Subsystem (Search, Scan, Install, Audit)
...

examples.description: Not found — returns alternatives to guide next call
